definitions.directory_entry: Metadata was observed in the official registry. This is not a code review, runtime probe, or integration test.
definitions.reviewed_repository: A repository was reviewed at the stated scope. This is not a security audit or proof that a server works.
definitions.working_integration: Reserved for a server that has passed an explicitly recorded end-to-end protocol/tool test. There are no records in this state yet.
